cases.title: library browsing shows profiles without opening or replacing a story
history failure stays visible in profiles and archive while known stories remain usable
native character editor owns Escape before its settings page and audio upload works by keyboard
character portrait and native actions stay above tags and notes at every size
new stories preserve previous transcripts and profile history resumes the exact scene
starting a character story is immediate, creates one transcript and can be renamed afterward
archive persists, excludes active lists, reads without editing, and restores the same transcript
rename follows archived identity and deletion requires confirmation without recreating the file
failed deletion keeps the story and reports the server failure
settings keep every native area reachable with Escape and focus restoration
advanced controls retain native provider, sampling, prompts and extensions without leaving the workspace
every settings category uses one control tree and fits desktop and phone
settings sections, blank space and external dialogs never close mounted controls
every settings destination keeps controls reachable with enlarged phone text
settings changes and late saves preserve every category through direct navigation
dictation settings remain available when the optional TTS extension is disabled
discovered selectors distinguish unapplied choices and follow native provider changes
vision discovery follows the native current-story-model option
one server configures native services and survives reload without replacing sampling or profiles
discovered context uses configured capacity, preserves manual overrides and survives reload
service prompt editors save native values and composer nodes survive classic round trips
fresh compatible connection migrates context preference
existing explicit compatible connection migrates context preference
service setup reports failure, missing capability and voice errors; stale requests cannot replace a new server
dictation handles permission failure and retry, preserves drafts, never sends, and cancels on story change
image writer preserves scene context and story model through failure and retry
live Juiced first reply with post-history instructions recovers through native prompt formatting
live Juiced services use native providers from the tested container
search opens character profiles and a fixture model generates through the native composer
mobile draft survives a frozen tab and reload without leaking into another story
a healthy reply completed while frozen resumes once and preserves the next draft
a reset stream after freeze preserves partial text without success actions or replay
a early-eof stream after freeze preserves partial text without success actions or replay
a multi-choice stream with all finish reasons handles EOF correctly
a multi-choice stream with only one finish reason handles EOF correctly
foreground retry coalesces events, refreshes CSRF and preserves explicit model settings
an unresponsive foreground heartbeat times out and can be retried without sending a reply
a pending native recovery save does not keep the connection check busy
a delayed read-only foreground check cannot reconnect a changed provider
story drafts survive rapid switching and rename while the native recovery preference is respected
legacy draft recovery is explicit and blocked browser storage retains text in this tab
identical story filenames on different characters never share a recovered draft
quiet prompt callers keep rejection on transport failure without automatic retry
a late microphone permission result after suspension is stopped and never transcribed
a completed reply stays recoverable until the native save succeeds
two replies with failed native saves both survive reload as recovery text
stopping a pending nonstreamed reply restores the composer and preserves its next draft
stopping a pending streamed reply restores the composer and preserves its next draft
a two-member cast handles stop without advancing the queue or losing its next draft
a two-member cast handles network loss without advancing the queue or losing its next draft
native streamed replies keep the composer and character identity mounted
image tools use the native provider and treat custom prompts as text
one scene click generates one native illustration with automatic tools off
voice tools narrate the latest native reply with the configured System voice
chat voice is opt-in and persists; manual images do not enable automatic tools
cast creation selects real characters and opens a group story
roleplay pages and composer stay within a 320px viewport
roleplay pages and composer stay within a 390px viewport
roleplay pages and composer stay within a 448px viewport
roleplay pages and composer stay within a 768px viewport
native font preferences and browser text sizing keep phone controls usable
classic preference survives reload and can be restored
message portraits fit their containers and stay clear of text across screen and font sizes
transient menus dismiss outside without closing persistent controls
transient menus dismiss outside without closing persistent controls
